RANDOM ROOT MODEL (owner 2026-10-02): a root's start model is a lottery and -model on a launch is not honored; codex-luna and agy-flash roots run one turn and exit. A continued session (-resume or upgrade) can only use a model of the SAME family as the session (claude session: haiku, sonnet, opus; codex: codex-luna; agy: agy-flash). Order one item per lottery root, read the Spawning line in the launch output, and relaunch when it exits. Another family exiting at once is a harness bug: trace its grievance in the chat log and send a grievance-squad sector.

ROOT LAUNCH MEASUREMENTS 2026-10-02: a NEW wkroot launch with a CLAUDE model (haiku, sonnet) is overridden by the launcher, a temporary measure because the other families were not tested enough (owner 2026-10-02): a launch asked for haiku became a codex-luna loop, while a non-Claude model IS honored (agy-flash really started agy and died at once on a 429 quota error), so state the model you actually got from the launcher process command line (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process, look for wkroot-codex.ps1 -run ... -model X) before reporting a root; a codex root re-spawns one codex exec per turn about every 9 seconds when each turn ends at once, which wastes the codex quota (189 rollouts in 10 minutes), so stop such a loop with wkappbot a11y kill and the loop pid; a persistent root needs -resume of a session that already has a transcript under 5 MB; the launcher shell finishing means the root loop exited.
